text: In a rural town, brothers Pedro and Jaime find a disembowelled corpse in the woods and, in a nearby shack, a man named Uriel who has become [a Rotten, carrying a demon waiting to be born|threat|being taken over]. The authorities shrug, so the brothers and the landowner [dump him far from the farm|wrong|abandonment and rejection]. Then a goat turns, a pregnant wife kills her husband, and every warning ignored, like firing a gun at a possessed animal, [lets the evil leap to someone new|rules|it passes to others] as Pedro races to reach [his ex-wife and sons|who_suffers|families and parents].
